nodes.endpoint: Week-36 LAVI change without baseline ECG atrial fibrillation/flutter

protocolGraph.interpretationLimit: The outer-box exit is transcribed as a group edge. Detailed transition/recycling algorithms, exact gate semantics, lock timing and actual testing implementation still require the final SAP and authorized statistical review.

methodHandoffs.finding: AM04 p4 states graphical alpha recycling and the LAVI baseline-AF restriction were amendment changes. The p66 original graph now has a page-level visual transcription.
methodHandoffs.remaining: Reconcile prior amendments and official registry versions with final dated SAP and database-lock/unblinding chronology. Do not infer misconduct or prespecification solely from later amendment text.

methodHandoffs.finding: Sections 9.3-9.4.2 distinguish all-randomized FAS from at-least-one-dose safety set. KCCQ uses MMRM; pVO2 uses ANCOVA. Missing-data and sensitivity detail is explicitly deferred to the SAP on p67.
methodHandoffs.remaining: Final SAP/version lock, analysis populations, model diagnostics, exact missingness algorithms and sensitivity outputs are not authenticated. Protocol populations do not resolve actual 516/517 accounting.

methodHandoffs.finding: Protocol p44 separates temporary interruption, permanent IP discontinuation and consent withdrawal. Permanent-discontinuation criteria include LVEF below 40% with concurrent HF SAE. Temporary LVEF-triggered interruption resumes only after LVEF reaches at least 60%.
methodHandoffs.remaining: Protocol intervention rules do not establish observed interruption counts, denominators, safety-set allocation, SAE coding or causality.

methodHandoffs.finding: PDF index7 reports HF SAEs 12/3 and LVEF<40% 7/0; index9 says all treated HF events occurred before week12 during titration, with two associated with LVEF<50%. Index6 lists first-composite-event HF4/1; this is a different endpoint numerator.
methodHandoffs.remaining: 11/1 versus12/3 remains unresolved: later reporting alone cannot prove later events. Need matched SAE definitions, cutoff, case listings and independent adjudication. 7/0 LVEF threshold events do not resolve the separately reported 14(2.7%) interruptions.
